messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync: ACME & Beta want an explicit launch gating for Optimize toolkit — they asked for eval-triggered alerts + quant recommendations before enabling on prod.
Luca (Eng): noted. do we mean runtime alerts (latency/cost) or model-quality alerts from evals?
Maya (PM): both. product ask clarified: when a quant/batching change causes >1% drop in QA pass rate on their test prompts, trigger an alert and auto-disable rollout.
Priya (ML): can we define 'QA pass rate'? is that exact-match, fuzzy F1, or a custom metric per customer?
Erin (Solutions): customers will provide a small prompt set + acceptance metric. ACME wants fuzzy similarity >= 0.95; Beta uses normalized F1. so metric needs to be parametric.
Luca (Eng): ok that implies eval-triggering pipeline needs per-customer metric config + a threshold mapping. ops impact: running evals on every rollout could be heavy.
Jon (SRE): agree. we should run evals as a pre-rollout job in CI and incremental checks during canary. also add a lightweight rolling quality sampler in prod.
Maya (PM): propose gating rules: (1) pre-rollout eval on pinned prompt set, must pass threshold; (2) canary: monitor sampled requests for regressions for 30m; (3) if triggered, auto-rollback and open a page.
Luca (Eng): implementation notes: pre-rollout eval uses the same model binary + quant profile. canary sampling hook will compute metric on anonymized requests and compare baseline with 10min sliding window.
Priya (ML): quantization-specific: warn customers about distributional shifts on long-context prompts. recommend conservative quant (e.g., 6-bit per-layer) for long-context rollout, automated fallback to float16 if eval regression detected.
Erin (Solutions): add a customer option to 'optimize for cost' vs 'optimize for quality'. saves us from one-size-fits-all thresholds. many small teams will pick cost and accept regressions.
Maya (PM): good. we need to ship: docs + UI for customer prompt set, threshold config, and an opt-in for automatic rollback. timeline?
Luca (Eng): rough eng estimate: pre-rollout eval infra + per-customer metric config = 2.5 sprint effort; canary sampling + rollback automation = 1.5 sprints. caching/batching recommendations UI tie-in = 0.5 sprint. total ~4.5 sprints.
Jon (SRE): we should also add an ops SLA for eval job runtimes and retention; e.g., pre-rollout eval must finish within 10m or mark as failed.
Priya (ML): add a small set of default metric templates (accuracy, F1, rouge, semantic-similarity) to make onboarding easier. also precompute embeddings for prompt-sets to speed checks.
Erin (Solutions): customer-facing checklist to ship to pilot customers: (a) upload 200-case prompt set, (b) choose metric template, (c) pick quality vs cost preference, (d) opt-in to rollback automation.
Maya (PM): decision points for this thread: 1) threshold must be customer-configurable. 2) default threshold = 99% concordance unless customer selects 'cost-first'. 3) require pre-rollout eval + canary sampling before GA. approve?
Luca (Eng): approve in principle. will need a spike for runtime eval perf and to instrument metric comparison.
Priya (ML): approve. will draft metric templates and provide quant fallback heuristics.
Jon (SRE): approve, will put SRE constraints in runbook.
Erin (Solutions): approve, will draft the customer checklist and onboarding doc.
Maya (PM): action items: @Luca run spike for pre-rollout eval latency (due EOW), @Priya draft metric templates (due next Tue), @Jon write runbook SLA (due next Wed), @Erin prep pilot checklist and sample emails. i’ll pull into roadmap slice.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: tool-optimize-eval-scripts -> staging at 3654321080 :eyes:
Luca (Eng): noted deploy-bot. will look at staging results and post a short perf note here.
Erin (Solutions): one more ask from ACME: a UI toggle to delay auto-rollback for up to 1 hour with manual approval. is that acceptable?
Maya (PM): can add as an advanced setting for enterprise tiers only. will capture in spec.
Priya (ML): corner-case: if metric is noisy for small prompt sets, we should add a minimum-sample floor before triggering rollback. suggest min 50 eval samples.
Jon (SRE): +1 on min-sample, and require statistical significance check (bootstrap CI) for change detection. keeps false alarms down.
Maya (PM): great. adding those to spec. thanks all — i'll circulate a one-pager and open a follow-up thread for acceptance criteria sign-off with ACME/Beta next week.
